findings: User-layer memory (labor_law.tm) enables isa/has/content Q&A without touching system lex.
user_dict aliases keep teach path clear of I11; keep aliases in user_dict, not system.tm.
Character pins can corrupt open names before they exist in domain; seed memory or avoid ambiguous chars on first teach.
Empty world correctly returns REN2 for labor questions — knowledge is not baked into system layer.
Latin user_dict keys must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]* (e.g. OT); tokens like N+1 are not rewritten.
Long utterances with spoken prefixes still peel D69/D67 spans; multi-fire joins answers with ；.
